summary: Sequans Communications S.A. filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, reporting its unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results via press release. The release details revenue of $7.5 million, a net loss of $9.8 million, and mentions adjustments to prior quarters related to convertible debt re-evaluation and purchase accounting. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, tender, restructuring, or other corporate event is described. The filing is a standard quarterly update for a foreign private issuer, so it does not qualify for any special-situations category.
